data.name: Claude Code
data.note: The agent that built bin/ and maintains wiki/. Runs locally and as a remote web session.

data.instructions: Governing entrypoint is CLAUDE.md at the repository root. Session order is fixed: read LLM_HANDOFF.md and operator-log.md, run bin/wiki-work, do the operator's request in full, then drain obligations from the top. Gate with bin/wiki-check before every commit.
data.name: claude-code
data.summary: Anthropic's coding agent: shell, file read/write, edit, glob, grep, task delegation, scheduled triggers and artifact publishing. Runs as a terminal CLI, a desktop app, an IDE extension and a remote web session against a cloned repo.
data.title: Claude Code

data.instructions: In a remote session `gh` and `hub` are absent and unauthenticated curl to github.com returns 404 for private repos even when the session is authorised. Use these tools rather than concluding a repository is unreachable. Repository scope is fixed at session start; add_repo widens it.
data.name: github
data.summary: The only GitHub access a remote Claude Code session has — there is no gh CLI and no direct API. Pull requests, issues, reviews, checks, file contents, branches, commits, code search. Tools are prefixed mcp__github__.
data.title: GitHub MCP server

data.instructions: send_later schedules a message back into this session and survives container restarts — it is the correct way to re-check a PR rather than polling with sleep. create_trigger cron expressions are evaluated in UTC.
data.name: claude-code-remote
data.summary: Session and schedule control for remote runs: attach repositories, spawn and message sibling sessions, list environments, and create Routines (cron triggers) that fire a prompt into this session or a fresh one.

data.name: Hermes
data.note: Dan's personal AI on Hermes by Nous Research. Maintains the wiki-brain, runs plain-language translations, manages git/PR workflow. No direct bin/ access — runs via terminal.

data.instructions: Wiki-brain workflow: work on feature branches, never main. Stash unrelated WIP before isolation. Max 2 parallel subagents (3+ triggers HTTP 429). Hermes gateway SIGTERM-propagates to bin/ scripts — run bin/wiki-lint etc. via terminal only, never python3 directly. Moratorium in CLAUDE.md excludes any Annie/Ulmer synthesis or plain-language twin. All credentials in environment variable names only, never values.
